documents.subject: Request for quotation: Volute casing HX 80-200
documents.author: Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing
documents.text:
Request for quotation for Volute casing HX 80-200 (part:310070), series HX (start of production March 2027), drawing rev. B.
- Annual volume: 4200 pc
- Material: EN-GJS-500-7, net weight 44 kg
- Delivery DAP Hollerau; please state price, payment terms, lead time and any tooling.
Invited: Eisengießerei Velkenreith GmbH, Tarsevi Döküm Sanayi A.Ş.

documents.subject: Visit by the owner
documents.author: Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing
documents.text: Visit by the owner of Eisengießerei Velkenreith GmbH. He reminded us that in 2022 they kept supplying at the old price for a quarter and said he expects partnership in return.

documents.subject: New contact person
documents.author: Eisengießerei Velkenreith GmbH
documents.text: From 1 October your contact in sales is our new colleague in inside sales; all other contacts stay the same.

persona.summary: Family foundry (240 staff, EUR 34.2 M, solid equity 38.5 %); we are only 1.4 % of its turnover but spend grew 30 %. Owner-led, expects partnership for the 2022 favour. Impeller HN 200 sells below its full cost (co-sourced 70 % with 70140, 70190 qualified); HN 250 is sole-sourced with no should-cost. Delivery is slipping badly (OTD 74.5 %, two amber quarters). It is invited to the HX 80-200 RFQ against Tarsevi: our best lever.
persona.notes: Expects partnership for the 2022 favour; the HX 80-200 RFQ (4200 pc/yr) is new volume we can offer. Fears losing HN 200 share to 70140/70190. Risk: we pay late (52 % of invoices over 5 days late), it may raise that. No price letter or cost claim on file.
fears: losing the new HX 80-200 business to Tarsevi

evidence.quote: in 2022 they kept supplying at the old price for a quarter and said he expects partnership in return.
part:310030 should-cost 35.98 vs price 34.26 (-4.8 %), own plant

levers: award of HX 80-200 (4200 pc/yr, SOP Mar 2027)
arguments: delivery scorecard: OTD 74.5 % vs 95 % target, amber two quarters, 2 open 8D
rival quote / active co-source 70140 on HN 200
notice period: prices fixed per calendar year
avoid: pushing HN 200 further below its cost
relying on HN 250 leverage (sole source, no should-cost)
changing terms after its final offer
tactics: Lead with the delivery scorecard: two amber quarters and OTD falling to 74.5 %.
Link price to the HX 80-200 RFQ: competitive pricing now helps its HX quote.
Push HN 250 harder than HN 200; HN 200 is already below its cost.
Offer a binding volume or HN 200 quota from 70140 for a visible price step.
Do not offer faster payment as a gift; fix our late payments only if it raises them.
playbook.expected_concession: No arena data; recent renewals asked +1.1 to +3.2 % and settled 0 to -1.4 % (2023: -3.9/-5.6 %); kept 43 % of its ask.
